essence: The practitioner should worship a distinguished man along with gods, fire, the guru, and brahmins.
After filling a dish, one should present the offering at a crossroads.
The practitioner accomplishes the tasks he has conceived, without exception.
Within a day one should face forward, throw, and chant ten thousand times.
One should perform recitation at midday while facing the sun.
